name: DocuSign
whatYouLose: Tamper-evident audit trails and mature evidence packages
Enterprise security reviews, retention controls, and integrations
prompt: Build an internal approval-signoff tool, not a legally equivalent e-signature service. Admins upload a PDF, place typed-name, date, checkbox, and approval fields, invite known colleagues by expiring signed link, and record an append-only audit log with timestamps and document hashes. Produce a final PDF and downloadable audit JSON. Use Astro SSR, SQLite, secure tokens, rate limiting, and clear copy stating that the tool is for low-risk internal acknowledgements only. Add threat-model notes and tests.
notes: A workflow that records acknowledgement is buildable. A legally defensible, globally compliant trust product is not a responsible one-prompt replacement.
